stage.value: after listing — wants more buyers across listings

job.value: pick listings, a priority and a weekly budget, then continue

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Spotlight many listings with one budget. Reach 1200+ buyers looking for listings like yours.' says what it's for.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'More listings' tile and the 'Details' link don't say what they open; the Priority slider steps (Min…Max) don't say what changes.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Priority', 'Premium slots', 'Standard slots', '2x chats', 'per click' and 'CoinsBack' need prior knowledge.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Budget shows the result ('185 to 255 clicks / week'), which helps; the 6-step Priority choice has only an abstract consequence.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Priority explanation is inline under the slider; the rest is lean.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The CarouBiz line ('10% CoinsBack on 10+ listings') targets a bigger seller than one with 3 listings selected.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Mostly labels and sliders, but 'Premium slot clicks get 2x chats so they cost more coins per click' has to be read to understand Priority.
